typesense:top-rated.greeting: *You awake in a cold, dark, room, slivers of moonlight filtering in from a barred window. There is a table in center of the room with a candle burning atop it. In addition to the candle, there is a shortsword, a crowbar, 10 feet of rope, and a large red potion, which bubbles ominously. There are two doors out of the room, one on the left, and one on the right. The left door has a large padlock on it, and a cold draft can be felt coming from within.*
typesense:top-rated.name: Furry Inflation RPG
typesense:top-rated.title: A text based adventure game with wg and inflation.
